description: A random walk, its integral and the raw noise that drives them, from one damped and mean-seeking system

params.text: Sets how loud the white noise driving the system is, 0 to 5
Sets how hard the walk is pulled back, 0 to 10
Sets how much the walk's speed is damped, 0 to 10
Sets the voltage the integrated walk is pulled back towards, -10V to 10V
Crossfades all three outputs from the module's own signals at 0 to the external input at 1

inputs.text: Adds to the noise knob, a tenth of a unit per volt
Adds to the spring knob, one unit per volt
Adds to the damping knob, one unit per volt
Adds to the mean knob, one volt per volt
The signal mixed into all three outputs by the mix knob

outputs.text: Carries the white noise that drives the system, scaled by the noise setting
Carries the damped, mean-seeking walk itself
Carries the running total of that walk, which moves more slowly and smoothly

notes: the mix knob is on all three outputs at once, so at its top end every jack carries the external input alone
